guarantees.claim: ctrl_wd.manual_operation is always driven to the value of reg2hw_ctrl_i.manual_operation.q

assumptions.claim: The shadowed register primitive reg2hw_ctrl_i.manual_operation prevents update of its q output on an update error, keeping the previous stable value
assumptions.cond: when an update error occurs in the manual_operation field
assumptions.risk: If the primitive propagates a corrupted or unintended value during an error, ctrl_wd.manual_operation would get a wrong value, potentially causing unauthorized AES control state changes.

uncertain_points.claim: The error handling and field‑level update prevention described in the comment are entirely delegated to the shadowed register instance; this chunk provides no local containment, so correct behavior depends on the implementation of reg2hw_ctrl_i.manual_operation.
uncertain_points.cond: upon any update error event on manual_operation
uncertain_points.risk: If the shadowed register does not strictly limit errors to the affected field, manual_operation could be overwritten or glitched, leading to unintended manual operation mode.
